alerts.title: Most Park Roads Closed to All Vehicles
alerts.description: Most roads are closed to prepare for commercially-guided snowcoach and snowmobile travel during the winter season, which will begin December 15 (weather depending). The road between the North and Northeast entrances is the only road open year-round to regular vehicles.

alerts.title: Traffic Delays - Gardner River High Bridge
alerts.description: Expect a single lane of traffic with up to 15-minute delays, 24 hours a day, seven days a week, from April 1 through November 24, 2026. Oversized/overweight vehicles (8'6"+ wide, 75'+ long, 80,000 lbs+ gross vehicle weight) will not be able to cross the bridge during this time.

alerts.title: Biscuit Basin Closed Due to Hydrothermal Explosion
alerts.description: The parking lot, boardwalk, and Firehole River at Biscuit Basin, located north of Old Faithful, is closed to all travel until further notice due to the possibility of another event at the site of a hydrothermal explosion that occurred July 23, 2024.

alerts.title: Vehicle Entrance Reservation Not Needed
alerts.description: Although an entrance pass is required to enter Yellowstone National Park, vehicle reservations are not needed. You are encouraged to purchase an entrance pass before arriving, but you may also purchase passes at any entrance station upon arrival.

alerts.title: Dunraven Pass (Tower Fall to Canyon Village) Temporary Closure
alerts.description: The road between Tower Fall and Canyon Village (Dunraven Pass) will close temporarily at 6 p.m. Sunday, Oct. 11 in preparation for winter weather and anticipated hazardous driving conditions. The road will reopen once conditions allow.
